method: Live Anthropic Messages calls with synthetic text: six per provider, all HTTP 200. DeepSeek low/high/max; both GLM models low/high/max. No quality or savings measurement. DeepSeek rates below are peak rates; z.ai rates are API list-price equivalents, not plan quota. New profiles checked 2026-10-31: primary documentation plus synthetic HTTP acceptance and per-activity JSON microchecks, not quality rankings. MiMo accepts effort-shaped fields but does not document depth differentiation; efforts is deliberately empty. MiniMax xhigh accepted raw but omitted from preset due client normalization risk.

cacheEvidence.deepseek: Repeated low/high requests reported 2688 cache-read tokens out of 2878 total input; first requests at each effort missed. This does not prove a guaranteed TTL or sharing across efforts.
cacheEvidence.zai: All six requests reported cache_read_input_tokens: 0 and omitted cache_creation_input_tokens. Native loopback acceptance confirms Claude Code supplies zero for omitted creation counts. Positive cache hits and TTL remain unverified.
cacheEvidence.minimax: Positive cache-read counters, no separate write premium or verified TTL.
cacheEvidence.mimo: Short raw requests omit both cache counters. Native engine normalization must be checked. No measured hit or TTL guarantee.
cacheEvidence.kimi: Short raw requests report zero cache writes/reads. Default cache-fill input priced at ordinary input rate; top-level 1h cache control is not used by this profile.
